name: Hidamari Nursery School
tagline: A small nursery school where children aged 0 to 5 can spend their days at their own pace.
credit: Photos are Poly Haven CC0 images (rooms) and computer-drawn placeholder rooms (corridor).

info.title: First visit
info.closed: Sundays, national holidays and the New Year period
bring: Maternal and child health handbook (when discussing enrollment)
steps: Book a visit (online or by phone)
Tour of the school (about 30 minutes)
Talk with us about enrollment
Apply at your city or ward office
info.note: You are welcome to bring your child to the visit.

pins.title: Front door
pins.text: Please use this door for drop-off and pick-up. A staff member checks your name on the intercom before opening the door.

pins.title: Office
pins.text: We handle paperwork and questions about enrollment here. Please call us to book a visit.

pins.title: Cars for drop-off
pins.text: The area outside the window is for drop-off. Please park in the marked spaces and turn off your engine while you wait.

pins.title: Toilets
pins.text: There are small toilets for children and a diaper-changing table. We work on toilet training together with each family.

pins.title: Soft play equipment
pins.text: Soft mats and play equipment suited to babies who are crawling or starting to stand.

pins.title: Large windows
pins.text: The sun comes in well in the morning. We use the curtains to adjust the light when it is too bright or at nap time.

pins.title: Dining table
pins.text: Baby food is introduced at each child's own pace and age. Please feel free to ask us about eating.

pins.title: Active play
pins.text: Children roll, climb and crawl through things using balls and mats.

pins.title: Bright windows
pins.text: Light comes in through the large windows. The windows have guards to prevent falls.

pins.title: Large mirror
pins.text: Children change clothes and do hand games in front of the mirror. They enjoy seeing themselves at this age.

pins.title: Cooking area
pins.text: Lunch and snacks are made here at the school. Please tell us about food allergies at the pre-enrollment interview.

pins.title: Serving counter
pins.text: Meals are carried from here to each room.

pins.title: Terrace
pins.text: On nice days, children sometimes have their snack on the terrace.

pins.title: Slide
pins.text: A low slide that small children can climb easily.

pins.title: Sandbox
pins.text: Staff check the sandbox every morning before use. It is covered when not in use.

pins.title: Lawn
pins.text: There is room to run and play ball. We put up shade in summer.

guides.title: Tour of the school
guides.desc: We walk from the entrance through each room to the garden.
steps: Welcome to Hidamari Nursery School. Let us show you around, starting from the entrance.
On the left is the office. We can talk about enrollment and visits here.
We walk down the corridor. The children's rooms are on both sides.
This is the room for 0-year-olds. Soft light comes in through the large windows.
We have soft play equipment suited to babies who are crawling or starting to stand.
This is the room for 1- and 2-year-olds. Children play with balls and mats and move their bodies.
Lunch and snacks are cooked in our own kitchen.
This is the garden, with a slide and a sandbox.
Thank you for visiting. To book a visit, tap “Contact”.

guides.title: A day at the school
guides.desc: Follow the children's day, from drop-off to pick-up.
steps: 7:00–9:00  Drop-off. A staff member receives your child at the entrance and asks how they are feeling today.
9:30  After the morning meeting, children play in their age-group rooms, with plenty of active play.
10:00  On nice days we go out to the garden and play on the slide and in the sandbox.
11:00  Lunch, freshly made in our own kitchen.
12:30  Nap time. We adjust the light with the curtains so children can rest.
15:00  After snack time, children change clothes and do hand games in front of the mirror.
16:00–19:00  Pick-up. Staff tell you how your child's day went.
